packages.name: Base map
packages.desc: Land, lakes and rivers of the whole globe (Natural Earth, public domain) and the map engine (MapLibre GL JS)

packages.name: Ancient landscape and states
packages.desc: Coastlines of the periods, empires and Roman provinces at several dates, names and areas of regions and peoples (Ancient World Mapping Center, ODbL)

packages.name: Ancient structures
packages.desc: Aqueducts, frontier walls, canals, city outlines and the roads of the Barrington Atlas (Ancient World Mapping Center, ODbL)

packages.name: Ancient places (Pleiades)
packages.desc: The Pleiades gazetteer (CC BY 3.0): about 40,000 places with their Greek and Latin names – finds the places named in a text and shows them on the map

packages.name: Relief – overview
packages.desc: Mountains and valleys of the whole map area, shaded; contour lines, heights, profiles of drawn lines; the depth of the seas (Copernicus DEM GLO-90, Natural Earth) – exact to about 1,000 m

packages.name: Relief – overview (detailed)
packages.desc: Mountains and valleys of the whole map area, shaded; contour lines, heights, profiles of drawn lines; the depth of the seas (Copernicus DEM GLO-90, Natural Earth) – exact to about 500 m

packages.name: Relief – Greece and the Aegean
packages.desc: For zooming in close: the terrain exact to about 100 m (needs the overview)

packages.name: Relief – Greece and the Aegean (detailed)
packages.desc: For zooming in close: the terrain exact to about 60 m (needs the overview)

packages.name: Relief – Italy and the islands
packages.desc: For zooming in close: the terrain exact to about 100 m (needs the overview)

packages.name: Relief – Italy and the islands (detailed)
packages.desc: For zooming in close: the terrain exact to about 60 m (needs the overview)

packages.name: Relief – Asia Minor
packages.desc: For zooming in close: the terrain exact to about 100 m (needs the overview)

packages.name: Relief – Levant, Cyprus and Egypt
packages.desc: For zooming in close: the terrain exact to about 100 m (needs the overview)

packages.name: Roman roads (Itiner-e)
packages.desc: About 300,000 km of roads of the Roman Empire – main and secondary, certain, conjectured or hypothetical, with the itineraries that name them (Itiner-e, CC BY 4.0); shown instead of the roads of “Ancient structures”

packages.name: Roman roads (Itiner-e, full detail)
packages.desc: The same roads with every bend, for zooming in close

packages.name: Natural Earth II
packages.desc: The painted landscape as a base map: shaded relief, deserts, green lowlands, rivers (Tom Patterson, Natural Earth, public domain) – sharp up to medium zoom

packages.name: Landscape – detailed
packages.desc: Coasts and lakes as exact as OpenStreetMap (edited by the Ancient World Mapping Center, ODbL), rivers and modern borders without simplification – for zooming in close (the base map is simplified)
